Gold on white is the combination that suits a room with brass or warm wood.

Self Adhesive
The self adhesive backing provides a direct way to attach the item to a compatible surface. Prepare the surface and align the position before pressing it into place.

Lightweight Design
The lightweight form is convenient to handle and move between suitable locations. It also makes the item easier to include when organising a bag or storage space.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

8941467526370.sourceDescription:
Four cow bells in an antique brass finish, threaded on twine at the top for hanging. Each bell is made from sheet metal with a deliberately rough, hand finished surface, so the gold tone varies slightly from bell to bell. Expect small marks and a slightly uneven patina: that is the intended vintage look rather than damage, and it is what separates these bells from a smooth, factory perfect copy.

The metal body is sturdy and weather resistant. It is waterproof, windproof and dustproof, easy to wipe clean and slow to rust or fade, which makes the set suitable for a porch, garden or shed as well as for indoor use. There is enough weight in the bell to hang straight and to sound like a real cow bell when it moves, rather than a thin decorative shell. A durable nylon braided cord is included for hanging.

Hang the bells from a window frame, wall hook, tree branch, staircase or door; a nail or small hook is all that most positions need. Use them as a jingle bell garland, a reindeer decoration or a golden accent on a Christmas tree, or let them chime as a wind chime in the garden. They also suit wedding decoration or a table centrepiece, and can stay on display all year.

A straightforward gift for a home, a garden, a birthday, Mother's Day, Father's Day, Thanksgiving, Valentine's Day or Christmas. Supplied as four bells with hanging cord.

Suitable for indoor and outdoor seasonal decorating, these baubles are a simple way to add depth, contrast and sparkle to your Christmas d cor. This beautiful artificial hinged Christmas tree is very lifelike in its shape and appearance and is meant to create just the right atmosphere for this Christmas. Hinged construction: The Christmas tree has a hinged construction, so the branches will automatically fold down at the right angle. Good to know:We recommend setting aside 45-60 minutes after assembly to properly shape the tree by peeling back the branches and pulling the tips apart to give the branches a more full-bodied look.

5022321559970.sourceDescription:
【High-quality material】Our Christmas tree skirt is made of high-quality non-woven fabric and shiny sequins. The dazzling sequins complement the soft velvet, creating a luxurious and elegant atmosphere. The sequined Christmas tree skirt sparkles under the lights, making your Christmas tree more delicate and beautiful. Alternative to traditional Christmas tree skirts.Replace traditional Christmas tree skirts with our chic and elegant Christmas tree skirts. Traditional Christmas tree skirts are laid on the ground like carpets and are easily dirty. This three-dimensional Christmas tree seat cover has less contact with the ground and is not easy to get stains. It can also cover the unsightly Christmas tree seat and can also be used as a Christmas tree decoration.

【Perfect size】Our Christmas tree skirt has a top diameter of 15.7 inches, a bottom diameter of 22 inches, and a height of 7.8 inches, which fits most standard-sized Christmas trees. Easy to assemble and durable: Our Christmas tree skirt can be easily assembled by simply sticking it with Velcro. Durable, the Christmas mat can be used as a charming Christmas decoration for a long time, the brightness of the sequins will not fade over time, you can just fold it and store it for the next event, saving valuable storage space.

【Multi-function Decoration】This Christmas tree stand decoration is very suitable for indoor and outdoor Christmas tree decoration, suitable for living room, garland, wedding, party, office, hotel, store, dance, Halloween, Thanksgiving, New Year's Eve, etc. Theme parties and scenes create a joyful Christmas holiday atmosphere for you.

Product Parameters
Material: Sequin Fabric
Color: Red
High-Quality Material: Made of premium non-woven fabric and shiny sequins, paired with soft velvet for a luxurious look; sparkles under lights, more elegant than traditional tree skirts.
Practical Design: 3D structure reduces ground contact (less prone to stains), covers unsightly tree bases, and doubles as decoration.
Perfect Size: Top diameter 15.7 inches, bottom 22 inches, height 7.8 inches – fits most standard Christmas trees.
Easy Assembly & Durable: Velcro for quick setup; sequins retain brightness, foldable for storage and reusable long-term.
Multi-Scene Use: Suitable for indoor/outdoor decor (living rooms, parties, offices, etc.), enhancing festive vibes for Christmas, New Year, etc. (Color: Red).

Product Overview

 This is a handcrafted artificial heart‑shaped pine wreath, featuring dense, lifelike long pine branches with rich natural layering. Equipped with a sturdy jute hanging loop on the top, it can be hung directly without extra assembly. Minimalist all‑green

Unique 24-inch heart shape: Unlike a traditional round wreath, the distinctive heart-shaped silhouette creates a warm and inviting focal point for your front door. The generous 24 inch size offers an eye-catching presence while maintaining a simple, natural style.
Universal Application​: ideal for indoor settings, this 1-pack wreath adds charm to fireplaces, mantles, or entryway walls; Made with materials that thrive in kinds of environments, it maintains its look in living rooms, kitchens, or bedrooms year-round
Wide Purpose​: on the far side of Christmas, this Christmas wreath serves as daily decor—pair with entrance hall decoration, bookshelves, or dining areas; Its versatile design transitions smoothly from holiday to everyday use

Brighten your home with this cheerful Christmas decoration. This plush snowman brings seasonal charm to your interior, because it features a tall red knitted hat, an orange carrot nose and a striped scarf. In addition, two red snowflakes decorate the fleece coat.
Place this standing snowman in your hallway to welcome festive guests. You can also position the indoor Christmas decoration beside the fireplace or next to the tree. What’s more, the festive snowman suits cosy living rooms, dining spaces and window sills.

Weighted red boots balance the snowman decoration firmly on flat floors, so it stays upright.

Brand: Samuel Alexander

Use: Indoor use only

FREESTANDING WEIGHTED FEET: Weighted feet keep your standing snowman stable on flat surfaces. Because it balances securely, you can position it in hallways, beside the hearth or near the tree.
CHARMING WINTER CHARACTER: Soft white fleece, an orange carrot nose, red mittens and a knitted hat create a classic plush snowman. In addition, festive red snowflakes detail the coat.
READY TO DISPLAY: This indoor Christmas decoration arrives fully assembled for effortless festive decorating. Simply unpack the piece, adjust the legs, and enjoy your holiday display.
NO POWER NEEDED: The non-lit design requires no cables or batteries, so you can place this freestanding Christmas snowman anywhere indoors without searching for electrical sockets.

Nordmann Fir is a hugely popular Christmas tree due to its rich green foliage, soft needles, and naturally well-balanced shape. The broad, sturdy branches provide plenty of room for decorations, while the foliage has excellent needle retention, helping the tree stay looking fresh throughout the Christmas period. The needles are also less prickly than many other conifers, making decorating easy and safe for little hands without the risk of being scratched.
A DISTINCTIVE NORDMANN FIR: The foliage has a rich green colour and a glossy appearance, while the needles are broad, soft, and blunt-tipped. This gives the Nordmann Fir its characteristic look and makes it a particularly popular variety for Christmas.
WHY CHOOSE POT-GROWN CHRISTMAS TREES?: This tree has been grown in its pot from the beginning, rather than being lifted from the ground and transferred into a container shortly before sale. Its roots have had time to develop within the pot as the tree has grown, without the disturbance of being dug up and moved. This makes it better suited to continuing its growth after Christmas, with a more established root system already growing in the pot. Unlike potted Christmas trees that have only recently been transferred from the ground, it can be kept outdoors and grown on after the festive season.
A REAL CHRISTMAS TREE THAT HOLDS ITS NEEDLES: Excellent needle retention helps the Nordmann Fir stay fresh-looking throughout the festive period, reducing the amount of fallen foliage as the weeks go by. Strong branches also provide good support for decorations.
GROW IT AS AN OUTDOOR CHRISTMAS TREE: After Christmas, move the tree back outside so it can continue growing in cooler conditions. As it develops, the evergreen foliage can also provide year-round interest among other evergreen trees for garden planting.
A POTTED REAL CHRISTMAS TREE FOR FLEXIBLE DISPLAY: Growing in a container means the Nordmann Fir can be moved to different positions as needed, making it easier to manage where the tree is placed. This also makes it possible to grow a Christmas tree without committing immediately to planting it permanently in the ground.
Please Note: Our pot grown trees are measured from the base of the pot to the tip of the tree.
